blocks.name: register_file
blocks.responsibility: Provide 32 32-bit integer registers with asynchronous reads, synchronous writes, asynchronous active-high reset, and hardwired x0 behavior.
blocks.design_rationale: Separating register state makes reset, x0 behavior, and writeback timing independently verifiable without adding datapath delay to the register reads.

blocks.name: alu
blocks.responsibility: Perform RV32I register and immediate arithmetic, shifts, comparisons, and logic, plus all RV32M multiply, divide, and remainder operations. Also produce branch comparison results.
blocks.design_rationale: Isolating arithmetic and comparisons makes instruction-operation coverage easier to verify and keeps the top-level datapath wiring clear.

blocks.name: control_unit
blocks.responsibility: Decode instruction fields and generate sign-extended I, S, B, U, and J immediates, register-write and memory controls, load/store sizing, operand selection, and writeback selection for RV32I and RV32M instructions.
blocks.design_rationale: Centralizing opcode-level decode and immediate construction makes control decisions and immediate bit mappings straightforward to inspect and test.

blocks.name: cpu
blocks.responsibility: Implement the single-cycle RV32IM processor: maintain and update the PC, instantiate the register file, ALU, and control unit, select ALU operands and writeback data, calculate effective byte addresses, extract and extend load data, and drive the instruction and data buses. Implement LUI, AUIPC, JAL, JALR, branches, all loads and stores, and RV32I/RV32M register operations.
blocks.design_rationale: Keeping PC sequencing, bus behavior, and datapath integration in the top-level preserves the required single-cycle external contract and makes the memory interface directly verifiable.

notes: Use only ieee.std_logic_1164 and ieee.numeric_std. The cpu entity is the sole top-level interface; instruction and data reads are asynchronous, stores are asserted during their instruction cycle, and PC/register reset is asynchronous and active high.
